title: AF-05 · Build the Support Case Flow

blocks.text: ДО ЗАПИСИ. Открой https://www.skool.com/salesforce-automation-mastery-2005/classroom/eeba9845?md=9f000ac96b16410d9288d63e2d49c1f3 и специальную Agentforce Employee training org. Проверь prerequisite предыдущей главы. Записывай фактический Builder и реальные synthetic records. При отсутствии функции запиши схему и явно скажи, что live проверка не выполнена. ГОТОВЫЕ ВСТАВКИ: https://sam-portal-production.up.railway.app/animations/agentforce.mp4. Анимацию используй как отдельное пояснение; UI показывай реальным снимком.

Create a Case that a human can find in a support queue. Handoff in this version means creating work for a human through a Case. A queue is a shared work list for designated employees; it does not mean a live operator has immediately joined the conversation. Omni-Channel and a public messaging deployment are not required for the main demonstration. The agent may report a Case number only after the Flow creates and retrieves the record successfully.

Setup → Queues → New. Use Label SAM Demo Handoff and Queue Name SAM_Demo_Handoff, select Case as a supported object, and add the training user as a member. Prepare a Cases list view for the queue. If the assigning user's configuration requires Transfer Cases, grant that specific permission and explain why; broad View All/Modify All is not the remedy.

Create an Autolaunched Flow (No Trigger), API SAM_Create_Demo_Handoff. Inputs: Text reason and optional Text testDriveId. Outputs: Text resultCode, resultMessage, caseId, caseNumber. Keep user context. Reject a blank reason with resultCode=INVALID_REASON and a useful message. If testDriveId is provided, retrieve the accessible Test Drive and return INVALID_BOOKING without creating a Case if it cannot be found.

cues.label: 05 · Resolve the queue and create the Case

blocks.text: Get Records on Group with DeveloperName=SAM_Demo_Handoff and Type=Queue. If absent, return CONFIG_ERROR. Create a Case with Subject='SAM demo: test drive assistance', a concise reason and accessible Test Drive ID in Description, the verified Status/Origin values, and OwnerId from the queue. Exclude full conversation dumps and sensitive customer data.

Store the created Id, retrieve CaseNumber by that Id, and return CREATED with the Case identifiers and a message that it entered the training support queue. Fault paths return FAILED without raw exception details. Save, Debug using a fictional reason, verify the Case in the queue, then Activate.

This minimal Case Flow has no durable idempotency key, so a repeated invocation can create another Case. After success, the conversation should reuse the returned number rather than invoke creation again without a new reason and confirmation. A production version needs backend duplicate protection and a policy for unknown outcomes; conversation instructions alone do not provide that guarantee.

ЭКРАН. Покажи expected/actual таблицу и соответствующий Flow debug, action trace или CRM record. Не подменяй результат live org симуляцией портала.

The handoff creates actual work rather than only a transfer sentence. Blank reasons and inaccessible booking IDs do not create a Case. Missing queue configuration is detected before record creation. A Case is visible with the intended queue owner and the same number returned by the Flow.
ПРИ ЗАПИСИ. Пауза для ответа. Покажи один из common failures и нужный диагностический экран.
A common mistake to avoid is this: Promising live chat transfer when only a Case was created. Keep the record or trace that supports your conclusion before continuing.
